name: card-stack
title: Card Stack
blurb: Cards stack and fan out with smooth animations on scroll.
description: Renders an array of cards in a stacked layout where they progressively fan out and scale. Configurable offset (gap between cards) and scaleFactor (how much smaller each card gets). Responsive animations as user scrolls or interacts.
use_when: Testimonials, reviews, or showcases where stacked cards add visual depth and engagement.
avoid_when: When cards need independent layouts — stacking constrains their positioning.
a11y: Card content (name, designation, content) is readable. Stacking is visual effect only.
